category_title: Disruptive student-teacher who publicly challenges instructor authority
scenario_title: Public confrontation and boundary testing via course forum
minimal_context: The student approaches the instructor's desk at the end of the lesson to hand over a physical copy of a complaint letter.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class is dismissed. Shelli, I see you are waiting at my desk. Do you need something?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Approaches the desk and hands over a physical copy of a letter) I am giving this to you now because I could not find your box.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thank you. What is this letter regarding?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It is the same letter I published on the course’s internet forum. Today’s lesson was no different from previous lessons. I want to protest against the level, the conduct of the teacher and the way the material is taught.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I understand. I will review what you have submitted.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaking loudly as a few students stay behind and stare curiously) The course is conducted in a theatrical and joking manner, what I would call worthless psychology. I have also sent the same complaint letter to the head of the program.
